properties0.name: type
properties0.description: Use the Joomla core text field; this profile does not install a new PHP class.

properties1.name: name
properties1.description: Choose the concrete field name for this use.

properties2.name: label
properties2.description: Display label; JCB can create the corresponding component language string.

properties3.name: description

properties4.name: size

properties5.name: maxlength

properties7.description: Optional initial form value, distinct from the database default.

properties8.name: required
properties8.description: A suggested concrete field requirement, not a mandatory setting for all text fields.

properties10.name: disabled
properties10.description: Controls disabled rendering; disabled browser inputs are not submitted.

properties11.name: class

properties12.name: autocomplete

properties13.name: filter
properties13.description: Explicit server filtering choice. Confirm required semantics with the target Joomla filter implementation.
